metadata.title: Will food reach your mouth or nose with your eyes closed ? Let's find out! Blindfolded Dinner, Delhi
metadata.description:
On World Disability Day 2024, we had the opportunity to be part of an extraordinary event organized by Delhi-based NGO Saksham Trust at The Arthouse Cafe. The evening offered a blindfolded dining experience that was as impactful as it was unique. It was aimed at promoting empathy and inclusion for the visually impaired.  

The event began with a fascinating activity where blindfolded guests were asked to identify everyday objects by touch. This simple yet powerful exercise gave us a glimpse into the challenges faced by visually impaired individuals in navigating the world.  

We also had the chance to interact with the founders of Saksham Trust, whose passion and dedication to empowering the visually impaired were truly inspiring. Everyone of us were excited yet curious for the blindfolded dinner experience, which was masterfully curated to heighten the senses of taste, smell, and touch.  

The multi-course meal was thoughtfully designed to emphasize textures, flavors and aromas, with detailed descriptions accompanying each dish to help diners imagine what they were eating. Guided by visually impaired hosts, the experience offered not just incredible food but also meaningful insights into their world.  

Throughout the evening, we realized how challenging it is to perform simple tasks without sight and how vital it is to create an inclusive society. The event concluded with a heartfelt interactive session, where guests shared their reflections about accessibility and awareness.  

Saksham Trust is doing remarkable work to empower visually impaired individuals and create platforms that foster understanding and inclusion. It was a privilege to be part of this transformative experience.
